payload.reason: The evidence provides specific examples of baseline methods used in the context of sentiment classification, particularly mentioning Naive and FANN as non-domain-adaptive baselines.

claims.text: Baseline methods include Naive, which uses bag-of-words representations and an SVM classifier trained on the source domain.
FANN is also mentioned as a baseline method that trains solely on the source domain.
These baseline methods do not adapt to the target domain, leading to less effective feature representation.
